insights.one_liner: Breda-based European arm of US frozen potato giant Lamb Weston, a recognised visa sponsor with an English-language finance role.

culture.text: Supplies frozen fries, potato, appetizer and vegetable products to restaurants and retailers in more than 100 countries.
The EMEA arm is based in Breda with about 908 people on LinkedIn; the whole group employs about 10,300.
Staff often come from Avans, HZ, HAS green academy, Wageningen and Tilburg, mostly in operations, sales and engineering.

open.text: Recognised IND sponsor through Lamb Weston B.V.
Its one current opening, a mid-level finance role in Breda, does not ask for Dutch and drew around 178 LinkedIn applicants.

worth_knowing.text: Lamb Weston B.V. is ultimately owned by US-based Lamb Weston Holdings, Inc.
